articles.title: Iran slams US attack on 'unarmed' vessel returning from India
articles.summary: A US submarine recently sank an Iranian warship off Sri Lanka's coast, eliciting a stern warning from Iran. Tehran stated the attack on its "unarmed ship" would not go with impunity, indicating escalating tensions between the two nations. This significant naval confrontation, occurring two days before Iran's warning, highlights a volatile international situation and raises concerns about potential military repercussions and regional stability.

articles.title: Assam Su-30 crash: Rajnath Singh condoles death of two IAF pilots
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh extended his profound condolences to the families of two Indian Air Force (IAF) pilots tragically killed in a Su-30MKI fighter jet crash. The incident occurred in Assam's Karbi Anglong district. Singh expressed deep grief over the loss, acknowledging the sacrifice of the brave air warriors in the line of duty.
